sql: select count(*) from approval_queue where block = 'farming' and object_type = 'harvest_forecast' and status = 'pending' and created_by = 'agent:VT'

select count(*) from approval_queue where block = 'farming' and object_type = 'harvest_forecast' and payload ~ 'IT-K0[34]: [0-9]{4}-Q[1-4] — [0-9]+–[0-9]+–[0-9]+ kg' and payload like '%harvest_assumptions_sha256: %' and payload like '%scenario_assumptions_sha256: %' and payload like '%thiếu dữ liệu%'
